sql: SELECT q.* FROM (SELECT m.match_id, m.start_time, m.duration, m.game_mode, m.lobby_type, m.leagueid, m.radiant_team_name, m.dire_team_name, m.radiant_win, CASE WHEN m.radiant_win THEN -(SELECT min(x) FROM unnest(m.radiant_gold_adv) x) ELSE (SELECT max(x) FROM unnest(m.radiant_gold_adv) x) END AS winner_max_deficit, ARRAY(SELECT p.hero_id FROM player_matches p WHERE p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.player_slot < 128 ORDER BY p.player_slot) AS radiant_team, ARRAY(SELECT p.hero_id FROM player_matches p WHERE p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.player_slot >= 128 ORDER BY p.player_slot) AS dire_team FROM matches m JOIN match_patch mp USING (match_id) WHERE mp.patch = '7.41' AND m.radiant_gold_adv IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN m.radiant_win THEN -(SELECT min(x) FROM unnest(m.radiant_gold_adv) x) ELSE (SELECT max(x) FROM unnest(m.radiant_gold_adv) x) END >= 20000) q ORDER BY q.match_id DESC LIMIT 6
